description: Rebuild the single-model Figure 7 and Supplementary Figure 3 recurrent-gate analyses using Figure 6-style marginal equal-n sampling for digit and sector contexts.
notes: Digit caches retain 4,583 sampled test frames per digit; sector caches retain 3,413 sampled test frames per sector.
Existing T_old masks are read before cache replacement so that only frame balancing changes.
Attempts r1/r2 exited before collection because nested-shell interpolation dropped the stimuli argument; retry r3 passes only literal absolute paths.
The r3 cache reconstruction completed, but an omitted vertical-render call stopped the final copy stage; r4 reruns plotting only.

The delta-g Figure 7 bars use unique-connection means within each |W| overlap band and display uncorrected Welch p-values: the raw group gap p-value plus independent bar-versus-zero stars for positive and negative bars.
